note: Sites the owner approves as inputs. Feeds only: no post text, no facts. Add or remove a line to change what the weekly job reads. Official sources are listed apart because a rights or news Reel may state a fact only from one of them. Listing pages are read by Google's fetcher through the Gemini API (URL context), because Reddit refuses cloud servers; they give titles and a short preview, with no score and no link. A page lists its readers in order, a ladder, most accurate first: "tavily" (Tavily Extract, the real page text; needs TAVILY_API_KEY; cannot read Reddit, which costs nothing to find out), "jina" (Jina Reader, free, no key, gives page text and links; Reddit refuses it), "gemini" (Google's fetcher through the Gemini API) The first that returns items wins; one that fails rests and is tried again the next day. A search is a broad query about the audience, never about a kind of story: the filter decides what is useful. Searches cost 1 credit each on the free Tavily plan (1,000 a month).

principles.note: Where lessons for managers come from: opinions of people who manage, research, and official guidance. The owner curates every line. A lesson is a perspective with a link, never a fact stated as settled.
